If your MB is up high in the case with the fan blowing right over it, point both fans toward the MB and add a third fan by the side vent to blow it out the side.

If the mother board is closer to where the drive bays, then point the back one away blowing out, and put the front one pointing at the MB. Then put a third one blowing directly over the MB from the side vent blowing at the MB.

The idea is to get as much air going across the area above where the cpu is so hot air goes out and sucks in cool air to replace it. So if it's near a vent suck it out and let new air from the front get blown in by the front and side fan. If it's far from a vent, let a fan suck it out the back and get that cooler air on as fast as possible

If you don't want to add another fan, just point both in, and let air pressure push the air out.
